metadata.question: Were black carbon AODs near the east of Australia, specifically within a 100km radius about (-34.344553, 157.706220), up during November 2019 to February 2020 in comparison to the same time the prior year?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about black carbon AOD (aerosol optical depth) near eastern Australia, comparing November 2019-February 2020 vs the same period the prior year (November 2018-February 2019). Key considerations: 1. Data source: Need to find black carbon AOD data. MERRA-2 has aerosol data including black carbon. 2. Location: Point (-34.344553, 157.706220) with 100km radius buffer 3. Time periods: Nov-Feb for 2019-2020 vs 2018-2019 4. Comparison: Check if values were "up" in the later period For MERRA-2, I'll use the M2T1NXAER collection which has aerosol diagnostics. The relevant band for black carbon aerosol optical depth would be 'BCEXTTAU' (black carbon extinction aerosol optical depth). Let me structure this: 1. Create geometry buffer 2. Define time periods 3. Get MERRA-2 collections for both periods 4. Calculate mean black carbon AOD for each period 5. Compare and determine if later period is higher 6. Handle edge cases (no data, no pixels, etc.) The MERRA-2 collection is quite reliable so I don't expect empty collections, but I'll still check. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([157.706220, -34.344553]); const region = point.buffer(100000); // 100km radius // Define comparison periods const period1_start = '2018-11-01'; const period1_end = '2019-02-28'; const period2_start = '2019-11-01'; const period2_end = '2020-02-29'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MERRA-2 for black carbon AOD const merra2_col = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GSFC/MERRA/aer/2'); const period1_col = merra2_col .filterDate(period1_start, period1_end) .filterBounds(region) .select('BCEXTTAU'); // Black carbon extinction aerosol optical depth const period2_col = merra2_col .filterDate(period2_start, period2_end) .filterBounds(region) .select('BCEXTTAU'); // Check collection sizes const period1_size = period1_col.size().getInfo(); const period2_size = period2_col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2018-19 Images: ${period1_size}`); console.log(`2019-20 Images: ${period2_size}`); if (period1_size === 0 || period2_size === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean black carbon AOD for each period const period1_mean = period1_col.mean(); const period2_mean = period2_col.mean(); // Get pixel counts and mean values const period1_stats = period1_mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 50000, // MERRA-2 resolution is ~50km maxPixels: 1e9 }); const period2_stats = period2_mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 50000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const period1_mean_val = period1_stats.get('BCEXTTAU_mean').getInfo(); const period1_count = period1_stats.get('BCEXTTAU_count').getInfo(); const period2_mean_val = period2_stats.get('BCEXTTAU_mean').getInfo(); const period2_count = period2_stats.get('BCEXTTAU_count').getInfo(); console.log(`2018-19 BC AOD: ${period1_mean_val?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${period1_count}`); console.log(`2019-20 BC AOD: ${period2_mean_val?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${period2_count}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (period1_count === 0 || period2_count === 0) { console.log("C2"); } else if (period1_mean_val === null || period2_mean_val === null || isNaN(period1_mean_val) || isNaN(period2_mean_val)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (period2_mean_val > period1_mean_val) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
